reviews.reason: At s0116 the narrative subject is Western Yan’s 慕容永 at Pingyang, afraid and seeking an eastern route; the same annal later treats 王永、苻纂 as attackers of 慕容永 (s0117), so the full form here is not interchangeable with those officers in those sentences. Retain accepted membership for p105; bounded zh:慕容永 dossiers are incomplete (8/19 visited) and do not prove or deny cross-chapter equivalence with every homonym header.

In s0200 姚萇 honors the slain Former Qin emperor as a spirit (謂堅有神驗; 立堅神主); the monosyllable 堅 in that cult speech is not the living 姚萇 named in the same unit (萇以登頻戰輒勝…). That rules out confusing this anchor with Yao Chang’s person record. Former Qin 苻堅 membership stands, but the massive zh:苻坚 index overflow cannot establish identity against every other dossier in one chapter pass.

s0184 opens with 苻纂 defeating 姚碩德 while 姚萇 holds 陰密 against 苻纂—the full name 姚萇 is the Later Qin founder opposing Fu clan generals, not 姚碩德. Later units keep 萇 as the active commander against 苻登. No source in this packet equates him with another 姚氏 figure under the bounded candidate headers; retain membership, but overflow on zh:姚苌 forbids asserting corpus-wide uniqueness.

s0288 names 張天錫 as regent who 以泮為冠軍、記室參軍; later units use 天錫 alone for the same Former Liang rulership context (s0289, s0293), not for any other Zhang in that household narrative. The abbreviated forms do not license merging with unrelated 天錫 dossiers beyond this chapter. Preserve canonical assignment; capped 張天錫/天錫 retrieval leaves homonym uncertainty.

The s0098 coalition list pairs place with name (扶風馬郎) among distinct commanders (姜延, 寇明, 王昭, etc.); 馬郎 is one listed respondent to 慕容丕’s call, not a pronoun for another entry. No bounded candidate bucket was disclosed for this case—within the sealed packet this supports the accepted single-local assignment without claiming external-corpus certainty.

s0303 introduces 弟菱 with offices under 張天錫 in the same breath as that ruler’s service structure; the graph 菱 is not used for 張天錫 or 索泮 in that sentence. Kinship short form matches p214’s accepted anchor and this chapter’s Former Liang staffing only—no candidate overflow in the sealed case.

s0318’s invective addresses 健 as the Jurchen-clan usurper who 竊鴻名—chronologically and rhetorically the founder 苻健, not his grandson 苻堅 (p159) who appears in later warfare units under 堅/苻堅 graphs. Membership for p223 is internally coherent; registry overflow on zh:苻健 and unrelated en:fu jian headers blocks corpus-wide identity closure.

s0089 lists 苻沖 with 車騎大將軍、尚書令 alongside distinct appointees (王永, 苻纂, 張蠔, 王騰, 徐義, 俱石子); each full name is a separate officer slot under 慕容丕’s government. The disclosed variant dossier (苻冲) is spelling normalization, not evidence of a second general in this sentence. Retain membership; index header alone does not remove cross-chapter review obligation.

s0041 closes with 此桓文之舉也—a classical shorthand where 桓 evokes Duke Huan of Qi paired with Duke Wen of Jin (p031’s 文); the annal is praising Fu Pi’s projected hegemony, not importing a living Spring-Autumn person into Jin history. 桓 is not 齊桓公’s full temple form in chapter Chinese. Title-reference local p030 stands; 齊桓公 dossier overflow cannot be resolved from this single rhetorical graph.

s0061 pairs 少康 with 光武 as achievable precedents for swift restoration (少康、光武之功可旬朔而成); the Xia restorer is a deliberate historical analogy in persuasion to Fu Pi, not an assertion that Shaokang acts in the Jin annal present. That reading excludes confusing him with any contemporary actor. Rhetorical attestation supports the local record; bounded zh:少康 headers remain non-proof for global merges.

Throughout the Fu Deng narrative arc (e.g. s0255 告堅神主, s0270 after 萇死, s0279 death) 登 is the Former Qin survivor-emperor fighting 姚萇/姚興—not 苻生, 苻纂, or other 苻 surnames that appear in other roles. s0279’s 登被殺 closes his storyline. Accept p185’s canonical role; overflow on zh:苻登 keeps cross-record equivalence open for unvisited dossiers.

s0098 lists 天水姜延 with 馮翊寇明 and others as separate geographic leaders answering 丕’s call; 姜延 is not the 江淹 (Jiang Yan) of Southern Dynasties literature in the lone index header—the characters differ (姜延 vs 江淹). Within-chapter coalition evidence supports p085; the unrelated candidate header cannot merge without contradicting the primary list.

s0129 identifies 父敞 as 苻登’s father, serving 健之世 and killed by 苻生—the 敞 graph matches Former Qin 苻敞, not 傅暢 or the unrelated 苻萇 homophone headers in the candidate bucket (different characters and narrative roles). Accept Fu Deng paternal line membership; four disclosed headers are not primary proof of separation or merge beyond bounded uncertainty.

s0052 names 左將軍竇沖 among northwestern governors (王統, 毛興, 王廣, 楊璧, 楊定) summoning 慕容丕 against 姚萇—an early warlord role distinct from the 竇沖 who later appears as 苻登’s general in the Wang clan betrayal episode (different narrative phase, same disambiguated local). This passage anchors the accepted dossier’s chapter entry; other 竇沖 dossiers in the capped index are not verified here.
